mapper.select: SELECT bp.post_id, bp.board_type_code, bp.user_id, bp.title, bp.content, bp.visibility_status, bp.pinned_yn, bp.created_at, bp.view_count, bp.updated_at, bp.deleted_yn, id.inquiry_category_code, id.inquiry_status_code, id.created_at AS inquiry_created_at, id.updated_at AS inquiry_updated_at FROM sd_board_post bp INNER JOIN sd_inquiry_detail id ON bp.post_id = id.post_id WHERE bp.board_type_code = 'INQUIRY' AND bp.deleted_yn = 'N' AND bp.visibility_status = 'PUBLIC' ORDER BY bp.created_at DESC
